description: This file defines an interface `IController` for plugin control within the WPEFramework project. It declares several pure virtual methods for controlling or querying the state of a plugin or component, such as persistence, deletion, reboot, environment, configuration, and cloning functions.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for controlling plugins or components within the WPEFramework, providing methods for persistence, deletion, reboot, environment access, configuration management, and cloning.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the current state or configuration of the controller.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a resource or configuration specified by 'path'.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the associated system or component.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves the environment variables or settings associated with a specified index.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Overloaded function to get or set the configuration for a given callsign. The first variant retrieves the configuration, and the second sets it.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Clones a plugin or component from a base callsign to a new callsign.

ctags.name: IController
ctags.pattern: /^struct DEPRECATED EXTERNAL IController : public virtual Core::IUnknown {$/
